pillars.title: Shared governance
pillars.description: Government, citizens and business make decisions at one table, working from the same data and the same targets.
pillars.description_id: Pemerintah, warga, dan swasta mengambil keputusan di satu meja — dengan data yang sama dan target yang sama.
pillars.results: [{"title": "Area protected through forum decisions", "value": "12k ha", "source": "Source: Regent Decree 2024 · updated Mar 2026", "description": "Designated after boundaries were agreed with communities and permit holders."}, {"title": "Derived regional policies", "value": "6", "source": "Source: LTKL Secretariat 2025", "description": "Including a district forum and a requirement to use one land data source."}]
pillars.results_id: [{"title": "Kawasan terlindungi lewat keputusan forum", "value": "12rb ha", "source": "Sumber: SK Bupati 2024 · diperbarui Mar 2026", "description": "Ditetapkan setelah batasnya disepakati bersama masyarakat dan pemegang izin."}, {"title": "Kebijakan daerah turunan", "value": "6", "source": "Sumber: Sekretariat LTKL 2025", "description": "Termasuk pembentukan forum kabupaten dan kewajiban memakai satu sumber data lahan."}]

practices.title: A district forum that meets every quarter
practices.title_id: Forum kabupaten yang bertemu tiap kuartal
practices.description: Eight agencies, two cooperatives and village representatives draw up an annual plan from one map.
practices.description_id: Delapan lembaga daerah, dua koperasi, dan perwakilan desa menyusun rencana tahunan berbasis satu peta.

practices.title: One dataset, one map, one plan
practices.title_id: Satu data, satu peta, satu rencana
practices.description: Land cover data is public, so planning no longer rests on a single party's claim.
practices.description_id: Data tutupan lahan dibuka ke publik sehingga perencanaan tidak lagi bergantung pada klaim sepihak.

pillars.title: Community-led sustainable economy
pillars.description: Farmer income rises without opening new land, because buyers pay for provenance rather than volume alone.
pillars.description_id: Pendapatan petani naik tanpa membuka lahan baru, karena pembeli membayar asal-usul produk, bukan sekadar volume.
pillars.results: [{"title": "Farming families in the sustainable commodity scheme", "value": "840", "source": "Source: Partner report 2025 · updated Jan 2026", "description": "Connected to buyers that require deforestation-free provenance."}]
pillars.results_id: [{"title": "Keluarga petani masuk skema komoditas lestari", "value": "840", "source": "Sumber: Laporan mitra 2025 · diperbarui Jan 2026", "description": "Terhubung ke pembeli yang mensyaratkan asal produk tanpa deforestasi."}]

practices.title: Peat pineapple absorbed by local processors
practices.title_id: Nanas gambut diserap industri olahan lokal
practices.description: Grown without clearing new land, then processed within the district.
practices.description_id: Ditanam tanpa membuka lahan baru, lalu diolah di dalam kabupaten.

pillars.title: Youth leadership
pillars.description: Young people from the districts run the programmes they will inherit, instead of being consulted about them.
pillars.description_id: Anak muda dari kabupaten menjalankan program yang akan mereka warisi, bukan sekadar dimintai pendapat.
pillars.results: [{"title": "Village initiatives led by young people", "value": "17", "source": "Source: LTKL Secretariat 2025", "description": "Each one budgeted and reported by the group that proposed it."}]
pillars.results_id: [{"title": "Inisiatif desa yang dipimpin anak muda", "value": "17", "source": "Sumber: Sekretariat LTKL 2025", "description": "Setiap inisiatif dianggarkan dan dilaporkan oleh kelompok pengusulnya."}]

practices.title: A youth cohort running the district data desk
practices.title_id: Kelompok muda yang menjalankan meja data kabupaten
practices.description: They keep the shared dataset current and answer requests from village heads.
practices.description_id: Mereka menjaga data bersama tetap mutakhir dan melayani permintaan kepala desa.
